page.overview:
Who is Teslyn Baradon?

Teslyn has bony fingers. No one had ever thought her beautiful. She is scrawny, with narrow shoulders, a gaunt face, and a narrow nose. She has dark brown eyes and thin lips. After her time as a damane, she fleshed out a bit.

Teslyn has a One Power strength of . This is above average strength for an Aes Sedai and strong enough to be able to Travel. Joline Maza calls Tesyln "inexorable" and unlikely to defer to anyone that did not have a significant advantage over her.

Teslyn possesses a decent ability at Healing, although not as good as Joline.

Teslyn is 130 years old, she was born in Illian in . She went to the White Tower in and spent seven years as a novice and five as Accepted. She was raised in .
